jobs.description:
Description

Are you looking for an innovative, fast-paced, highly-collaborative environment? If so, come join Worldwide Retail Growth and Development! The Worldwide Retail Growth and Development team is responsible for the strategic planning, acquisition, design, construction, launch, and maintenance of Amazon Worldwide Grocery Stores' real estate assets. This includes Whole Foods Market, Amazon Grocery Stores, and Amazon Grocery Logistics.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Tech to drive adoption of first-party (1P) and off-the-shelf AI products across internal teams at Amazon. This role will accelerate AI innovation within day-to-day workflows at the individual and team level. The role will also own and maintain 1P enterprise products through and beyond their initial development phases.

Key job responsibilities

Own the evangelization, measurement, and go-to-market plan for internal personal and team-level AI agents that improve business productivity.
Drive adoption of 1P AI products across our internal customer base by developing and executing targeted adoption plans.
Create marketing materials that communicate the value of 1P internal AI products to a broad internal audience.
Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and directly build personal and team-level AI agents to address those needs.
Define, track, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and customer impact.
Identify complementary use cases across Amazon to extend the value of existing AI products.
Help train and guide our internal teams on tools available for use, and best practices for using AI chatbots and helping to create personal and team workflows.

About The Team

The Retail Growth & Development team is at the forefront of expanding and optimizing Amazon's physical retail presence. We oversee strategic planning, development, and operations for a diverse portfolio of grocery stores and logistics facilities. Our team combines innovative thinking with operational excellence to create exceptional shopping experiences for customers. We're passionate about sustainable growth and committed to building the future of retail through collaboration, creativity, and customer obsession.

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, External Services, AWS Billing
jobs.description:
Description

We're building the next generation of AWS enterprise contract automation, making deal creation autonomous, intelligent, and self-service. You'll define the AI-powered platform behind billions of dollars in AWS private pricing agreements, serving customers from mid-market companies to the world's largest enterprises. This is the foundation for how customers commit to AWS and how AWS delivers on those commitments accurately and at scale.

As Principal Product Manager - Technical External Services, you'll define the future of our contract automation platform including AI-powered systems that can draft, simulate, negotiate, ingest, and validate contracts without manual intervention. You'll define how AWS represents commercial intent as structured data, establish governed libraries of reusable contract terms and negotiation policies, architect the guardrails that make autonomous contract generation safe, and build the self-service experiences that let customers of different size configure and commit to agreements through digital channels. Your work directly determines how quickly AWS can close enterprise deals, whether contracts produce accurate billing from day one, and whether customers can self-serve commitments without sales engagement.

In this role, you'll define product strategy that spans multiple years, driving initiatives that fundamentally change how enterprise agreements flow through AWS. You'll architect complex data models for ambiguous commercial domains, design how AI agents generate and negotiate contracts within defined boundaries, and build simulation and decision-support capabilities that help deal teams model revenue impact and make better commercial decisions before committing. You'll establish the mechanisms — operating cadences, metrics, escalation paths — that make contract automation delivery repeatable across multiple organizations. You'll conduct direct research with deal teams, enterprise customers, and commercial operations teams to understand where the contracting process creates friction, translating those insights into product requirements.

You'll collaborate with engineering teams across AWS's billing, agreements, and commercial operations organizations, as well as applied science teams building the AI models that power drafting and negotiation. You'll partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align contract automation with go-to-market strategy for enterprise and mid-market segments. You'll mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar across the organization. This role requires deep understanding of how AI agent systems work and how to constrain them safely, combined with the cross-organizational influence to bring diverse stakeholders together around a common vision.

If you're passionate about building systems that fundamentally change how enterprises transact in the cloud, and excited about defining how AI transforms the most complex commercial negotiations at scale, this role offers the chance to create AWS's contract automation platform from the ground up — serving everyone from deal negotiators managing billion-dollar relationships to mid-market customers self-serving their first private pricing agreement.

Key job responsibilities

Define product strategy spanning multiple years, driving contract automation initiatives from concept through production
Architect the machine-readable data model that represents AWS's commercial agreements as structured, actionable data, including reusable contract terms and policy rules
Design AI-powered contract generation and negotiation experiences with appropriate guardrails and escalation mechanisms
Define self-service contract experiences for enterprise and mid-market customers
Build simulation and data-driven decision-support capabilities for deal teams
Establish mechanisms that make cross-organizational delivery repeatable
Conduct direct research with deal teams and enterprise customers to validate product direction
Partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align with go-to-market strategy
Mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
6+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using data modeling experience
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
Experience building deep client and agency relationships

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in computer architecture
Experience with contract lifecycle management, legal tech, or enterprise deal automation
Experience with billing, commerce, or financial systems at scale
Experience working within teams delivering software products using agile methodologies
Experience mentoring junior product managers and leading teams of product managers

jobs.description:
Description

Own a priority area of Amazon Quick and shape how agentic AI changes work for the world's most demanding enterprise customers. This role is for someone who has gone deep in a complex or regulated field and wants to turn that expertise into products practitioners can't work without.

You will own strategy and execution end to end, work side by side with enterprise customers and their executives, and turn real domain insight into measurable value.

Own a priority area end to end, from strategy and roadmap through delivery and adoption
Work directly with enterprise customers and their executives, inside their environments

Key job responsibilities

You own the strategy and execution for a priority area of Amazon Quick, from first idea through delivery and adoption. You learn how your customers work, what they need, and what earns their trust, then turn that into product capabilities that matter.

Own the roadmap for your area: pick the high-value use cases, sequence the investments, and set clear adoption and revenue targets
Turn hard customer needs, like domain data models, compliance-aware access, and complex workflows, into clear requirements for engineering and science

Shape how agentic AI works for expert customers, and build the capabilities they need with AWS science and Bedrock teams

We build the product that helps the world's largest enterprises put agentic AI to real work. We sit where product vision, business strategy, and hard technical problems meet, and we partner closely with AWS Industries, ProServe, and the field to carry Quick the last mile into enterprise accounts.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Air Cargo, Amazon Air Cargo
jobs.description:
Description

You’re a Principal Product Manager – Technical with deep experience in supply chain systems, consumer experience, or logistics product strategy within complex, rapidly scaling organizations. You’ve owned end-to-end product vision for customer-facing and platform capabilities at scale, and you have a track record of turning operational infrastructure into differentiated experiences that drive business growth. You excel where the problem spans platform engineering, operations, commercial strategy, and consumer behavior — and you bring the strategic judgment to define the right long-term bets while delivering near-term value.

You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable diving deep into delivery economics, attainment-loss and failed-delivery patterns, geocode-confidence and address-quality data, and consumer behavior to identify where experience and platform investment drive outsized cost and revenue impact. You understand that this is not project management — this is setting direction for capabilities that touch every shipment Amazon Air Cargo delivers.

High judgment is expected at the Principal bar: defining the right experience and quality bar, making trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer delight, deciding when to build versus influence a platform team’s roadmap (and avoiding tech debt and duplicated systems), and influencing across operations, platform, commercial, finance, and engineering teams without direct authority. You set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to, you regularly engage with senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions, and you are relied on to be right a lot. You have a proven track record of building delivery, platform, or consumer experiences that became a durable competitive advantage.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Product Management Define the executive-level vision for address quality and recipient experience and translate it into actionable multi-year roadmaps aligned across partner organizations, operations, product, commercial, and engineering. Proactively surface risks and opportunities with data-driven recommendations to senior leadership; frame the strategic asks (not just feature lists) that move platform partners from reactive collaboration to proactive co-investment. Innovate on behalf of the recipient and the shipper while balancing operational priorities, commercial needs, and cost; own end-to-end outcomes and business impact (delivery success, failed-delivery and lost-package rates, premium-service revenue, cost per shipment, customer satisfaction).

Cross-Team & Platform Leadership Lead product vision and execution across multi-org dependencies, including driving alignment across the routing and delivery-execution systems and a joint engagement model with the platform teams that own the underlying geospatial capabilities. Eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the address-to-doorstep journey; own the build-vs-influence calls and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home.

Operational Excellence & Scale Design products and platform capabilities that scale with volume growth without proportional increases in manual exception handling (e.g., address corrections, missed pickups, support contacts). - Use data to identify and eliminate the highest-impact friction points across address quality and the recipient journey. Build the governance and review mechanisms that keep cross-org investment aligned year over year.

A day in the life

Set the strategic direction for address quality and recipient experience across teams — aligning partners around shared outcomes, not just deliverables.
Deep dive into data (failed-delivery patterns, geocode confidence, post-delivery feedback, delivery economics) to shape the intervention roadmap and decide where to invest engineering resources for maximum impact.
Challenge and refine technical designs with engineering and platform leaders, ensuring solutions scale with network growth and don’t create long-term tech debt.
Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting technical progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and on the ground to pressure-test whether what we’re building actually works in the real network.

What this takes

Someone who toggles between deep technical/platform depth and strategic product leadership — turning complex operational and geospatial challenges into scalable, automated, experience-led solutions that recipients love and shippers choose Amazon Shipping for.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager - Agentic AI, Velocity Labs
jobs.description:
Description

The Velocity Labs team mission is to think beyond the confines of the normal product-orientated approach and to discover new ways to apply and embrace agentic AI. We have noticed how the open-source community, and some of our competitors, experiment with new ideas, and deliver initial products fast. With Velocity Labs we are building an organization that can move faster, explore more, and make sure AWS is at the cutting edge of innovation in agentic AI.

You’ll join a deeply technical team that includes applied scientists, software developers, and other technical product managers. You’ll have the opportunity to partner with a wide variety of teams that are involved in building foundational agentic services for AWS, as well as a wide variety of agentic services that target different personae (e.g., software developers and business users) and use cases. The industry is at an inflection point related to foundation models, generative AI and agentic use cases; you will be a key player for AWS in this historic period of innovation.

We are specifically looking for a Principal Technical Product Manager who brings core skills in working backward from customer needs and also a high degree of skill in partnering with experts in automated reasoning. It is neither necessary nor expected that you be an automated reasoning expert, but it is critically important that you have the ability to develop collaborative relationships with such experts so that together you can understand what is possible, then work together to make that happen.

Key job responsibilities

Lead the definition and delivery of services and tools that help enterprises and system integrators automate the modernization of their code assets.

Identify new product opportunities and write their business proposals.

Drive the coordination and clear communication of a multi-product roadmap, working across multiple groups.

Work with engineering and design teams to define fast-paced, but realistic schedules.

Create the pricing, product positioning, and go-to-market plans.

Enable the sales team with product training and collateral.

Create and drive a community engagement plan.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Adobe Lightroom Creative Pro
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Lightroom is the world’s leading photography ecosystem, empowering photographers to edit, manage, store, and share images across desktop, mobile, and web.

As professional photography is reshaped by AI, automation, new client expectations, and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape, we are looking for a Director of Product Management to help define what the modern professional photography workflow becomes next.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with deep product leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency in professional photography. You will represent the needs of photographers currently engaged with Lightroom, helping teams understand where pros need more speed, quality, trust, creative control, and workflow efficiency. You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy.

Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences.

This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control.

What You’ll Do

Shape the Creative Pro product agenda

Lead key product strategy workstreams for the Creative Pro audience across Lightroom surfaces including desktop, mobile, and web.
Identify high-value opportunities across professional workflows, including ingest, culling, editing, retouching, masking, batch editing, collaboration, client review, delivery, and archive.
Translate photographers’ jobs to be done into clear product principles, requirements, priorities, and success measures.
Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years.

Represent professional photographers inside Adobe

Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography.
Build relationships with professional photographers, educators, creators, camera partners, and industry experts to keep Lightroom grounded in real-world workflows.
Bring hands-on photography fluency into product reviews, prototypes, roadmap discussions, launch planning, and executive conversations.
Help teams distinguish between technically impressive ideas and experiences professionals will trust in production.

Imagine and ship new experiences

Partner with teams in advanced technology, design, and engineering to shape new capabilities into experiences photographers love and rely on.
Define how AI, agents, and automation should show up in Lightroom to save time, improve quality, reduce repetitive work, and expand creative possibility.
Balance innovation with quality, performance, reliability, transparency, and user
control.
Drive clarity and alignment across cross-functional teams, strategic forums, planning cycles, and executive discussions.

Ground decisions in insight

Stay close to the tools, services, communities, and workflows professional photographers use today.
Develop a strong point of view on where Lightroom should lead, where it should partner, and how we can exceed expectations of our most advanced customers.
Connect customer insight, product quality, adoption, retention, monetization, and competitive differentiation into precisely structured product recommendations.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Proven experience as a senior product leader who has defined strategy and shipped high-impact products, ideally for creative, media, professional, technical, or workflow-intensive customers.
Deep understanding of professional photography workflows, including speed, quality, consistency, client expectations, high-volume production, and creative control.
Strong product taste, with the ability to evaluate whether an experience meets the bar for professional use.
Experience turning ambiguous customer needs, emerging technology, and business goals into well-defined product strategy, tradeoffs, and shipped outcomes.
Experience partnering deeply with research, design, engineering, and product marketing to deliver customer-facing products at scale.
Experience with AI, automation, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic experiences, holding a clear stance on trust, control, quality, and user value.
Executive-level storytelling and influence, especially in senior IC roles where impact depends on alignment rather than direct authority.
Strong analytical judgment, showing proficiency in combining usage data, customer research, market signals, competitive insight, and hands-on craft expertise.
Excellent collaboration skills, high ownership, and a demonstrated ability to build trust with photographers and internal partners alike.

Strong Plus

Over 10 years spent working professionally as a photographer specializing in one or more genres.
Experience teaching, mentoring, writing for, or building community with photographers.
Experience collaborating with camera manufacturers, lens makers, imaging hardware companies, or other photography ecosystem partners.
A photography portfolio, shipped product examples, writing, talks, or other work that demonstrates extensive knowledge of professional creative workflows.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Technical, Core Shopping Data Science
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon cannot fix a customer experience problem it cannot measure. Our team's job is to make shopping quality measurable: to find the defects customers actually encounter, quantify how often they encounter them, and put a number in front of leadership that teams are willing to be held to. Today that capability is strongest on the search results page, where we run a portfolio of quality metrics covering areas such as relevance, duplication, and brand quality, backed by a mix of human annotation and LLM based measurement.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager - Technical to own the quality bar for core shopping: the standard that defines what counts as a customer visible defect, how precisely it must be measured, and what evidence is required before a number can be trusted. You will drive alignment on that standard across the organizations whose experiences it judges. Owning the bar is the job. Measurement and inspection are how you enforce it: you will own the quality metric portfolio for the search page, the inspection mechanisms that surface the defects we are not yet measuring, and the scalable mechanisms (human annotation, LLM based evaluation, and the audit loops that keep both honest) that hold the system together as coverage grows. You will expand that coverage beyond search to other core shopping surfaces, including the Homepage and Detail Page.

Key job responsibilities

Define The Quality Bar

Own the standard that every metric definition, annotation SOP, and automated measurement approach must satisfy before it can be trusted or published. Scientists, engineers, and annotation partners build to that bar.
Own the portfolio of shopping quality metrics against that bar, covering areas such as relevance, duplication, and brand quality, and grow that portfolio as new defect classes are identified.

Own the inspection mechanisms

Own how we find quality defects, not just how we count the ones we already know about: sampling strategy, audit cadence, anecdote review, and systematic inspection of pages customers actually saw.
Turn qualitative signal into quantified metrics. Work with UX Research and leadership to convert customer anecdotes and research findings into defect definitions that can be sampled, scored, and tracked.
Own the audit loop and the SOP bar. Specify what gets audited and against which criteria, review findings, and require the resulting corrections in annotation SOPs or LLM prompts. When a measurement approach systematically misses a defect class, you own defining what the corrected standard is, and the team builds to it.

Drive quality measurement into online systems

Drive the agenda to move quality measurement from offline, after the fact reporting into online systems, so that quality signals are available where experiences are ranked and served rather than only in a periodic report.
Partner with central platform teams to embed quality metrics into online evaluation and serving paths.
Make the case for where online quality signals change decisions, including experimentation guardrails, faster detection of quality regressions, and closed loop correction of defective experiences.

Own the roadmap

Own the multi year roadmap for shopping quality measurement and inspection: which defects to measure next, which surfaces to expand to, and what each expansion unblocks for the business.
Extend the charter beyond search to other core shopping pages, starting with Homepage and Detail Page. For surfaces with no measurement today, define the defect taxonomy from scratch: what a quality defect is on that page, how it is sampled, how it is scored, and how it rolls up.
Drive alignment across Organic Search, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and International as definitions evolve, including with the teams whose experiences the metrics judge.

About The Team

The mission of the Core Shopping Data Science team is to provide the data-driven foundation for building a world-class shopping experience that maximizes long-term free cash flow by delighting customers. We focus on the long term and big picture to ensure that the full Amazon shopping experience balances strategic trade-offs. We believe data science is the discipline of making smart decisions and we empower feature owners and systems by 1) developing and vending metrics which assess and value customer engagement, 2) building tools and datasets to inject data into the decision-making process, and 3) delivering deep analyses to inform high-touch decisions.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

We're hiring a Head of Community to turn our current set of programs into a function that helps millions of people build real skills with Claude, measurably growing retained users and product adoption.

You'll lead and grow a global team that covers ambassadors programs, regional community leads, and enterprise champion programs. Your job is to give this team a sharp operating model and a measurement framework that ladders our initiatives to business outcomes, so users can get the most out of Claude. You'll build community across audiences, seniority levels, functions, and roles: enterprise buyers and executive sponsors, developers and technical practitioners, and the knowledge workers in between. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, PMM, Brand, and Comms.

Own the global community strategy and operating model: the audience thesis, the portfolio of programs, and what's built centrally vs. run in-region
Lead, coach, and scale a global team of program and regional owners; hire the gaps, set the bar, and develop community-native operators
Define the measurement framework that replaces activity metrics: partner with Product and Data Science to define success metrics and segment the base (non-user → occasional → high-value daily) — with recurring retained users and product adoption as the top-line outcomes
Build community across the full range of audiences and seniority levels, with programs and voice tuned to each without fragmenting the experience
Connect bottoms-up adoption to enterprise expansion: architect the champions, train-the-trainer, and partner ecosystem motions that turn power users inside accounts into org-wide adoption, and integrate them into how Sales and CS run strategic account plans
Bring training, certification, enablement, and community help together into one engine that scales through champions and partners — so users experience a single path to skill-building with Claude
Partner tightly with Brand and Comms to keep sentiment and awareness healthy: define where community shows up in Anthropic's brand and how we best serve our users
Align community strategy proactively with product direction, launches, and pricing & packaging — owning community's job pre-launch, at launch, and post-launch, and proving it drives value for our users

Run community or advocacy at a company operating both a PLG / self-serve motion and an enterprise sales motion at the same time
Built or led a recognized champions, ambassadors, or advocacy program at a company known for the model
Experience with developer tools, infrastructure, or AI products, and credibility with technical audiences
Built the measurement plumbing for a community function before including cohorting, attribution, and usage segmentation
International experience standing up or scaling community in-region (EMEA, Japan/APAC) with a clear philosophy on what runs centrally vs. locally

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Adobe Builders eXperience (ABX)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

In the last 6 months, agentic development has taken off – changing how software is built. We have a clear vision on how to embrace it, and an engineering org already in motion. We need a product leader to take the spark and own the connection with the builders we serve. They will turn it into strategy and keep evolving that strategy as frameworks, tools, and processes change.

Join us in the ABX org, where agentic development is the platform – a managed harness that 15,000 builders at Adobe will use to ship software with AI. Every improvement you will make compounds across engineering, product, and design, on most codebases at Adobe!

This is a build role. You'll develop the strategy, build the organizational framework from the ground up, and set the bar for what agentic development looks like at Adobe.

What You'll Own

The Builders Experience strategy.
Take an articulated-but-evolving vision and transform it into written strategy, roadmap, and objective measures of success. Expect it to change continuously as the models, harnesses, and internal processes evolve.

The platform spanning all three modes of agentic development.
ABX will serve builders wherever they are on the curve, and make each mode repeatable:

Agentic Delegation - individual acceleration; the SDLC stays the same, each function just gets faster.
Agentic Transformation - cross-functional AI pods that compress the SDLC and dissolve role boundaries.
Agentic Orchestration - ticket-to-PR factories, multi-agent loops, self-healing CI, with customer and SRE signal closing the outer loop.

The objectives and key results (OKRs).
Platform adoption → per-engineer output → per-employee productivity → business impact. We start with adoption and build up to the rest.

The relationship with the builders.
Deepen trust with the Adobe Builders community, as past decisions on models and tooling created friction. You'll build the engagement mechanisms for a real partnership, and act as chief marketer and evangelist for the platform across the org!

Build vs. buy.
Own the decision process for which external models and tools we deploy. Know the latest across the labs, hyperscalers, and open-weights - and make high-conviction calls amid an embarrassment of riches.

Execution.
Relentless focus on shipping. Remove bottlenecks, streamline how the team communicates, and automate our own SDLC intelligently - designing the moments where humans stay in the loop so judgment and taste get applied at the junctures that matter.

The operating model.
Design how this team runs, in partnership with engineering. It must be agentic itself - we build the system with our system and eat our own dog food. Expect AI pods with real ownership, some led by non-PMs and product-design-engineer (PDE) profiles, not the classic backlog-and-execute approach.

A small PM team.
Direct one PM today (who owns external-tool deployment decisions) and grow the org as the mandate expands - setting the hiring bar and the culture as you go.

What You'll Bring

Senior PM leadership with a track record of building strategy and teams from scratch
Technical credibility with builders. The best instinct here is an engineer's instinct for what engineers want - we're building tools for people who like to build their own tools. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read it and reason about it.
Deep technical fluency in agentic systems: model evaluation and selection, orchestration frameworks, evaluations, inference cost, MCP and the surrounding dev-tooling stack. Comfortable debating latency-vs-accuracy tradeoffs with principal engineers.
Strategic clarity under ambiguity. The landscape shifts weekly; you will synthesize signal from noise, make high-conviction bets on incomplete information, and adjust course as needed.
Comfort operating lean and unconventionally - small team, novel AI pods structure, strong bias to action, allergic to process theater and fluff.
A driver of reinvention - energized by collapsing role boundaries and remaking the SDLC to be AI-first.

What Sets You Apart

You've led product for a developer or AI platform inside a large engineering org (hundreds to thousands of engineers), and driven adoption of AI-augmented development tooling at scale.
You're boundary-less - you'll collaborate across Adobe and go where the outcome takes you.
You can converse across the whole agentic stack: agentic coding, CI/CD, build systems, observability, evaluations, orchestration.
A technical degree (CS, Math, Engineering, or related) or equivalent experience. We value what you've built over where you studied.

Be ready for

A vision that will change, repeatedly. We optimize for agility over certainty.
A team that's small by design, with a non-standard operating model you'll co-invent.
Being both architect and customer of what we build. That reinforcement loop - the system building itself, and getting smarter every time Adobe builds on it - is our MO.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Job Description

This leader will drive the transformation of OCI's infrastructure delivery model by shifting

engineering and construction activities from the field into manufacturing environments through

modularization, off-site assembly, skidding, and integrated product development. The

organization will partner closely with Design Engineering, Architecture, Supply Chain,

Manufacturing, Construction, and strategic OEMs to develop scalable infrastructure products

that improve deployment velocity, reduce field labor, enhance quality, and increase consistency

across OCI's global fleet.

The Product Engineering organization will own the product strategy and lifecycle for

standardized infrastructure modules, including integrated mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and

controls assemblies. This includes defining product requirements, influencing supplier

technology roadmaps, managing OEM partnerships, developing product qualification strategies,

and driving Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles

throughout the engineering lifecycle.

A key responsibility of this organization will be identifying opportunities to convert traditional

stick-built infrastructure into repeatable, modular products that can be manufactured, tested,

transported, and deployed at scale. Areas of focus include integrated cooling systems, power

distribution assemblies, skidded mechanical plants, prefabricated electrical rooms, combined

CDU/fan systems, Heat Absorption Chillers (HAC), piping assemblies, controls packages, and

other standardized infrastructure solutions that improve scalability and deployment efficiency.

Working across the entire infrastructure lifecycle, this leader will ensure modular products align

with OCI's design standards, manufacturing capabilities, construction methodologies, operational

requirements, and long-term technology roadmap. The organization will also partner with OEMs

to influence future product development, ensuring suppliers build products optimized for OCI's

unique scale, performance, and deployment needs.

The ideal candidate combines deep experience in product engineering, modular construction,

manufacturing, critical infrastructure systems, and supplier development with a demonstrated

ability to build engineering organizations and commercialize innovative infrastructure

technologies at hyperscale.

Responsibilities

Build and Lead the Function

Establish and scale OCI's Product Engineering organization focused on modular infrastructure and industrialized construction.- Develop the organization's strategy, operating model, product lifecycle processes, and execution roadmap.
Build multidisciplinary engineering teams spanning product engineering, systems

engineering, manufacturing engineering, supplier engineering, technical program

management, and product lifecycle management.

Establish engineering processes supporting concept development, product qualification,

manufacturing readiness, deployment, sustaining engineering, and product evolution.

Modular Infrastructure Strategy

Define and execute OCI's long-term modularization strategy across mechanical,

electrical, plumbing, structural, and controls infrastructure.

Identify opportunities to transition field-built infrastructure into standardized modular

products.

Develop reusable product platforms that enable consistent deployment across OCI's

global data center portfolio.

Establish product architectures that improve scalability, reduce deployment timelines,

and simplify installation and commissioning.

Continuously evaluate emerging modular technologies and manufacturing capabilities to

improve deployment efficiency.

Product Engineering & Lifecycle Management

Own the engineering lifecycle for OCI's modular infrastructure product portfolio.
Define product requirements, technical specifications, validation plans, qualification

criteria, lifecycle management strategies, and product roadmaps.

Lead cross-functional product development from concept through production deployment and sustaining engineering.
Ensure products meet OCI requirements for performance, reliability, manufacturability,

serviceability, and lifecycle cost.

Partner with Design Engineering to integrate standardized products into future data center

design platforms.

OEM Partnerships & Supplier Development

Develop strategic engineering partnerships with OEMs, contract manufacturers, and

technology suppliers.

Influence supplier product roadmaps to align with OCI's long-term infrastructure

strategy.

Lead joint product development initiatives that deliver differentiated infrastructure

solutions.

Evaluate emerging technologies and commercial products for adoption into OCI's

modular infrastructure portfolio.

Establish engineering engagement models supporting product qualification, validation,

manufacturing readiness, and continuous improvement.

Off-Site Manufacturing & Industrialized Construction

Lead OCI's strategy for off-site assembly and factory-built infrastructure.
Develop engineering standards supporting Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for

Assembly (DFA), and Design for Off-Site Manufacturing (DfOSM).

Partner with manufacturing organizations to optimize factory integration, quality,

logistics, and deployment sequencing.

Increase factory acceptance testing and pre-integrated systems to reduce field

commissioning and startup activities.

Drive initiatives that improve installation productivity while reducing schedule risk and

Field Labor Requirements.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner closely with Design Engineering to ensure modular products integrate seamlessly

into OCI's standardized facility designs.

Collaborate with Engineering Systems to support new product introduction (NPI), FOAK

validation, and engineering change management.

Work with Construction and Commissioning teams to optimize installation, startup, and

operational readiness.

Partner with Supply Chain and Manufacturing to develop sourcing strategies and

manufacturing capacity plans.

Provide executive leadership on modularization strategy, product roadmaps, supplier

partnerships, and deployment initiatives.

Qualifications

Required Experience

15+ years of experience in product engineering, modular infrastructure, manufacturing

engineering, critical infrastructure, or related technical leadership roles.

7+ years leading engineering or product development organizations.
Experience developing modular or prefabricated infrastructure solutions for mission-

critical facilities, industrial systems, or large-scale manufacturing environments.

Deep expertise in product lifecycle management, systems engineering, and hardware

development.

Experience working with OEMs and strategic suppliers to develop custom products.
Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and integrated

infrastructure systems.

Experience driving Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and

industrialized construction initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in hyperscale cloud or AI data center infrastructure.
Experience leading modular data center or prefabricated infrastructure programs.
Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and engineering change

processes.

Experience developing factory-built infrastructure products and off-site manufacturing

strategies.

Experience with global supplier development and manufacturing operations.
Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing

Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Leadership Characteristics

Visionary leader with a passion for transforming how critical infrastructure is designed,

manufactured, and deployed.

Strong systems thinker capable of balancing engineering, manufacturing, supply chain,

construction, and operational considerations.

Innovative product development leader with experience commercializing complex

infrastructure technologies.

Collaborative executive who builds strong partnerships across internal organizations and

external suppliers.

Results-oriented leader with a bias toward execution, standardization, and continuous

improvement.

Excellent executive communication and influence skills with the ability to shape long-term technology and supplier strategies,

jobs.description:
Description

Automotive and Manufacturing is one of AWS's highest-priority industry verticals and a centerpiece of Amazon's broader enterprise strategy. Our vision is to be the most trusted technology partner for the world's automotive and manufacturing companies as they navigate the greatest transformation in their history: the convergence of AI, electrification, and software-defined everything. Three industry forces make this moment urgent: (1) the rapid shift to software-defined vehicles and autonomous mobility is rewriting how cars are built, sold, and operated; (2) generative AI and agentic AI are unlocking a new generation of smart factories, predictive supply chains, and industrial automation at scale; and (3) manufacturers are under intense pressure to reduce costs, localize production, and build resilience against geopolitical and tariff disruption. AWS is uniquely positioned to help customers across all three, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a truly global leadership position. You will lead teams spanning North America, Brazil, Europe, Korea, Japan, and India, operating across cultures, time zones, and market dynamics. Beyond AWS, you will coordinate with other Amazon business units, including Alexa+ (voice and ambient AI for automotive), Project Leo (satellite connectivity), Amazon Ads (in-vehicle and retail media), Amazon Supply Chain Services, and Amazon Business, to bring the full breadth of Amazon's capabilities to automotive and manufacturing customers. Few roles at AWS offer this combination of strategic scope, global scale, and cross-Amazon impact.

In this executive-level leadership role, you serve as the Global Industry Specialists & Solutions (ISS) leader for the Automotive & Manufacturing (A&M) Industry Business Unit, leading the industry solutions architecture, business development, and GTM teams that shape how automotive and manufacturing companies adopt AWS at scale. As a leader of leaders, you will build and run a global team driving end-to-end industry-solutions strategy across software-defined vehicle (SDV) and autonomous mobility, customer experience, smart manufacturing, supply chain, and other lines of business areas. You engage with C-level decision makers, VPs of engineering, manufacturing. and other business areas, bringing fluency in cloud and applied AI/GenAI for industry use cases. You operate within a matrixed, global organization, while elevating AWS's thought leadership presence across the automotive and manufacturing industry while collaborating across sales, service teams, and partner organizations to drive transformational business outcomes for customers on their AI-driven journeys

Key job responsibilities

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Dataverse
jobs.description:
Overview

Dynamics 365 and Power Platform depend on a core data platform that manages business data, transactions, security, extensibility, and application lifecycle at enterprise scale. As customers modernize their applications and adopt AI, the platform must keep data governed, available, and economically sustainable while supporting the controls expected of enterprise business systems.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager
to lead product strategy for the core data platform behind Microsoft business applications. You will set strategy and investment priorities across Dataverse and Finance and Operations data-platform capabilities, including data governance and lifecycle management, storage economics, integration, reliability, scale, and the partner ecosystem. You will also guide how supported interfaces and emerging agent integrations build on that foundation. The portfolio spans important Finance & Operations (F&O) scenarios and shared platform capabilities used across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

This Redmond-based role offers broad product ownership at an important point in the evolution of enterprise applications: shaping the data foundation used by business applications, analytics, and AI. You will work closely with engineering teams, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform product teams, Microsoft AI product groups, customers, and ecosystem partners, with regular exposure to senior leaders as you drive decisions that are visible in customer experience and business results. The role is well suited to a product leader who enjoys making difficult platform choices, building alignment across organizational boundaries, and measuring success through customer outcomes.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Business Applications core data platform, with clear priorities and measurable customer and business outcomes.
Set modernization priorities for data-platform reliability, scalability, extensibility, and supported access patterns, including clear platform contracts and investment choices.
Use customer research, partner input, and product data to identify the highest-value business data scenarios, then drive reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
Set product requirements for availability, performance, observability, compatibility, administrator control, and task completion across enterprise application and AI scenarios.
Define how Dataverse, Finance and Operations, and shared data-platform services should work together, including where storage, integration, extensibility, application semantics, and AI capabilities should converge and where product boundaries should remain explicit.
Set the product strategy and external positioning for data governance and lifecycle management across the core platform, including policy-based retention, archiving, safe deletion, recoverability, and administrator tools that help customers manage data responsibly at scale.
Shape storage economics and capacity-management strategy across the platform, including entitlement clarity, usage insights, and predictable customer paths for addressing sustained overages; balance customer outcomes, platform cost, and sustainable growth.
Partner with security, trust, and governance leaders to incorporate identity, authorization, policy, audit, and compliance requirements into core data-platform capabilities and supported AI scenarios.
Partner with product economics and business-planning leaders to develop commercial models, pricing and packaging inputs, and evidence-based investment cases for core platform capabilities.
Lead ecosystem strategy across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform product teams, Microsoft AI products, independent software vendors, and systems integrators; translate commitments into reusable data-platform capabilities and a prioritized engineering roadmap.
Partner with domain product leads to connect core platform strategy with application-specific administration, migration, lifecycle, compliance readiness, and customer outcomes.
Define and review the scorecard for platform adoption, reliability, storage efficiency, ecosystem usage, AI scenario success, and paid growth; use the evidence to guide investment and deprecation decisions.
Represent the core data-platform vision and roadmap with enterprise customers, partners, the field, and senior Microsoft leadership, and communicate tradeoffs clearly across technical and business audiences.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech (PMT), HR Experience Technology
jobs.description:
Description

Own the product strategy for the agentic AI platform and cross-platform shared services that power HR experiences for 1.8 million Amazonians. As a Principal Product Manager - Tech in our HR Experience Tech (HRXT) team, you’ll lead product delivery for the horizontal intelligence layer—Agent Skills (our AI-native no-code automation platform), Employee 360 (the unified employee context layer), and the integration, orchestration, and routing infrastructure that makes every HR interaction smarter, faster, and more consistent across all personas.

This is a rare opportunity to define how AI agents work in HR at Amazon. We’re building the PXT skill catalog—the governed library of agentic workflows that any compatible AI agent can execute. HR professionals author deterministic, auditable workflows in plain language. These skills combine procedural knowledge (step-by-step instructions, edge cases, business rules), permissioned data access (via PXT MCP Gateway connections to E360, Case, Timehub, ETM, Manager Hub, Engage, ADAPT), and the ability to apply business rules across multiple systems to produce reliable, auditable outcomes. You’ll own this platform end-to-end—from the authoring experience through governance, versioning, and production execution.

You’ll work across a multi-product technology stack spanning agentic AI workflows, intelligent routing, automated communications, employee data platforms, and cross-platform integration layers—coordinating across all of these to deliver seamless end-to-end HR experiences while designing for Service Central, our converged AI-first platform. You’ll partner with HR operations leaders, AI/ML scientists, engineering teams across HRSC, USC, PXT CMS, and domain experts to build the composable automation framework that makes every HR team more effective.

This role demands someone who can think in platforms and composability—building horizontal capabilities that amplify every vertical team’s impact. A single Agent Skill you ship gets used by 7,000 contact center agents, 11,000 Ops HR users, 500 corporate HRBPs, and 308 investigators. A single MCP integration you connect unlocks data access across every AI experience in the stack. You’ll leverage agentic capabilities, conversational AI, intelligent orchestration, and unified employee context to transform HR support from reactive case processing to proactive, AI-driven employee experiences.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision and strategy for Agent Skills—the AI-native no-code automation platform that enables HR professionals to author, govern, version, and deploy agentic workflows in plain language, embedded in HRSC and USC.

Define and scale the PXT skill catalog—building the governed library of reusable HR workflows, establishing quality standards, governance frameworks, and the discovery/sharing mechanisms that compound institutional knowledge across the organization.

Lead Employee 360 (E360) product strategy—expanding from a data retrieval tool to a context-aware agentic platform that integrates 10+ AI workflows, enabling HR professionals to complete complex tasks through natural language with comprehensive employee context.

Own PXT MCP Gateway product direction—the registry/gateway providing Maple-permissioned connections to HR data systems, including tool filtering, auth, matching, and the roadmap for onboarding new data sources that feed both E360 and Agent Skills.

Own Auto Work Assignment (AWA) evolution—building intelligent routing that considers agent skills, workload, case complexity, and organizational context to optimize resolution time and quality across all HR domains.

Define the automated communications framework—AI-backed, template-driven correspondence at case milestones that reduces manual drafting across all personas while maintaining quality and personalization.

Lead the closed-loop experience standard—defining how cross-platform case visibility, handoffs, and task assignment work across USC, HRSC, PXT CMS, and domain boundaries (Payroll, Ops, Corp, Investigations).

Own PXT One product direction—the centralized intake platform for PXT improvement requests, providing voice-of-the-field, leadership visibility into trending themes, and mechanisms to reconcile misaligned priorities.

Drive platform analytics and Insights—delivering cross-persona reporting, operational dashboards, and the metrics infrastructure that measures automation impact, adoption, and quality.

Ensure all cross-platform services are designed as native Service Central capabilities, influencing Phase 3 architecture decisions and ensuring convergence-alignment across every investment.

A day in the life

Your morning begins reviewing Agent Skills adoption dashboards—you’re tracking how many HR professionals have authored new skills this week, which skills have the highest execution volume, and where the authoring experience is creating friction. You notice a skill authored by a Central HR team lead has been forked and adapted by three other teams—a signal that the governance and sharing model is working. You also review E360 agentic workflow completion rates and identify a newly integrated MCP tool that’s driving a 40% reduction in employee lookup time for Corp HRBPs.

Mid-morning, you join a working session with the HRSC team to define the closed-loop experience for a newly onboarding domain. Payroll is coming onto USC, and their cases frequently require handoffs to Ops PXT users in HRSC—you’re designing the cross-platform visibility, task assignment, and case handoff workflows that let both teams collaborate without context loss. You validate that AWA routing will correctly assign cases at each handoff point and that the automated communication templates fire at the right milestones to keep employees informed throughout resolution.

After lunch, you lead an Agent Skills design review with engineering. A new skill for leave-of-absence eligibility verification chains three MCP tools (Timehub, CTK, and policy data via E360), applies multi-step business logic, and produces an auditable determination. You ensure it follows the skill catalog’s governance standards—deterministic execution, version-controlled, permission-scoped via Maple—and validate that the automated communication template fires correctly when the skill completes.

In the afternoon, you present your Q3 cross-platform services roadmap to HRXT leadership. You frame the portfolio through the Service Central lens: Agent Skills becomes Service Central’s automation runtime. E360 + MCP Gateway becomes the context and integration backbone. AWA becomes the intelligent routing brain. Closed-loop becomes the cross-platform coordination standard that connects every persona. You demonstrate how one Agent Skill authored for Central HR automatically works in Service Central for any persona—the platform compounds with every skill added.

You end your day in a pre-flight session for the upcoming Agent Skills Demo with PXT leadership. You’re preparing to showcase how the platform has moved from concept to production: real HR workflows authored by HR professionals (not engineers), executing against live employee data, producing auditable outcomes. You highlight the compounding effect—every new skill signals which MCPs to onboard next, and every verified skill becomes an org-wide standard that replaces ad-hoc tribal knowledge.

About The Team

The HR Experience Technology (HRXT) team is on a mission to fundamentally reshape HR work at Amazon. We bring together PXT (People Experience and Technology) teams and harness technology to provide seamless, intuitive experiences for HR teams serving all Amazonians. Our vision focuses on elevating HR service delivery through integrated technology solutions that span multiple platforms and touchpoints.

We own six major product areas—USC, HRSC, PXT CMS, Investigations, PXT One, and M&A Integrations —plus the cross-platform services layer that makes them all work together. We serve over 18,000 HR users globally, handle 30M+ interactions per year, and are actively converging toward Service Central: one AI-native platform for ALL of HR.

Our team culture embraces innovation and experimentation, particularly in applying agentic AI to transform HR workflows. Agent Skills launched in April 2026 with strong early product-market fit, putting automation directly in HR professionals’ hands. E360 launched in December 2025 on Aza and is expanding to 10+ agentic workflows. We’re at the inflection point where these platforms compound—and this role will lead that acceleration.

As part of our team, you’ll work with talented engineers, product managers, ML scientists, and designers who are passionate about using technology to transform the employee experience. Join us to define how AI agents work in HR at Amazon.

Experience with end to end product delivery

Description

Sellers' trust in Amazon is our top priority. In this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by launching new products and developing novel means to measure our progress.

Invention has become second nature at Amazon, and the pace of innovation is only accelerating. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new products, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.

This is a global role that will include interaction with teams in countries outside of the United States, requiring a strong ability to communicate effectively and understand the different needs of global customers. Your decisions are not only fundamental to the viability and attractiveness of our offering for Sellers, but they will in turn drive selection, revenue and growth of our overall business.

The Senior Product Manager-Tech is a bar-raising communicator, verbally and in writing. This role requires clear articulation of complex problems and proposed solutions, and requires high judgement to ensure the right leaders are involved in decisions and regularly informed on progress. This role aligns teams towards clear priorities and advocates for investment delivering large, complex business initiatives, with clear mechanisms that audit progress towards shared goals and regularly reports results to ensure long-term business success. Define and evolve the product strategy and vision grounded in customer needs, internal insights, and external analysis.

You demonstrate high skill at using data to drive decisions. You use AI capabilities to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment.

You collaborate with other product managers, sharing mental models for decision-making, providing feedback on documents and strategies, and helping others grow their technical and strategic capabilities. You raise the bar for the PM community through knowledge sharing and thought leadership.

Description

Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.

Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing

Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against

Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements

Description

We're building the next generation of AWS enterprise contract automation, making deal creation autonomous, intelligent, and self-service. You'll define the AI-powered platform behind billions of dollars in AWS private pricing agreements, serving customers from mid-market companies to the world's largest enterprises. This is the foundation for how customers commit to AWS and how AWS delivers on those commitments accurately and at scale.

As Principal Product Manager - Technical External Services, you'll define the future of our contract automation platform including AI-powered systems that can draft, simulate, negotiate, ingest, and validate contracts without manual intervention. You'll define how AWS represents commercial intent as structured data, establish governed libraries of reusable contract terms and negotiation policies, architect the guardrails that make autonomous contract generation safe, and build the self-service experiences that let customers of different size configure and commit to agreements through digital channels. Your work directly determines how quickly AWS can close enterprise deals, whether contracts produce accurate billing from day one, and whether customers can self-serve commitments without sales engagement.

new_jobs.description:
Description

You’re a Principal Product Manager – Technical with deep experience in supply chain systems, consumer experience, or logistics product strategy within complex, rapidly scaling organizations. You’ve owned end-to-end product vision for customer-facing and platform capabilities at scale, and you have a track record of turning operational infrastructure into differentiated experiences that drive business growth. You excel where the problem spans platform engineering, operations, commercial strategy, and consumer behavior — and you bring the strategic judgment to define the right long-term bets while delivering near-term value.

You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable diving deep into delivery economics, attainment-loss and failed-delivery patterns, geocode-confidence and address-quality data, and consumer behavior to identify where experience and platform investment drive outsized cost and revenue impact. You understand that this is not project management — this is setting direction for capabilities that touch every shipment Amazon Air Cargo delivers.

High judgment is expected at the Principal bar: defining the right experience and quality bar, making trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer delight, deciding when to build versus influence a platform team’s roadmap (and avoiding tech debt and duplicated systems), and influencing across operations, platform, commercial, finance, and engineering teams without direct authority. You set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to, you regularly engage with senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions, and you are relied on to be right a lot. You have a proven track record of building delivery, platform, or consumer experiences that became a durable competitive advantage.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Product Management Define the executive-level vision for address quality and recipient experience and translate it into actionable multi-year roadmaps aligned across partner organizations, operations, product, commercial, and engineering. Proactively surface risks and opportunities with data-driven recommendations to senior leadership; frame the strategic asks (not just feature lists) that move platform partners from reactive collaboration to proactive co-investment. Innovate on behalf of the recipient and the shipper while balancing operational priorities, commercial needs, and cost; own end-to-end outcomes and business impact (delivery success, failed-delivery and lost-package rates, premium-service revenue, cost per shipment, customer satisfaction).

Cross-Team & Platform Leadership Lead product vision and execution across multi-org dependencies, including driving alignment across the routing and delivery-execution systems and a joint engagement model with the platform teams that own the underlying geospatial capabilities. Eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the address-to-doorstep journey; own the build-vs-influence calls and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home.

Operational Excellence & Scale Design products and platform capabilities that scale with volume growth without proportional increases in manual exception handling (e.g., address corrections, missed pickups, support contacts). - Use data to identify and eliminate the highest-impact friction points across address quality and the recipient journey. Build the governance and review mechanisms that keep cross-org investment aligned year over year.

A day in the life

Set the strategic direction for address quality and recipient experience across teams — aligning partners around shared outcomes, not just deliverables.
Deep dive into data (failed-delivery patterns, geocode confidence, post-delivery feedback, delivery economics) to shape the intervention roadmap and decide where to invest engineering resources for maximum impact.
Challenge and refine technical designs with engineering and platform leaders, ensuring solutions scale with network growth and don’t create long-term tech debt.
Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting technical progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and on the ground to pressure-test whether what we’re building actually works in the real network.

What this takes

Someone who toggles between deep technical/platform depth and strategic product leadership — turning complex operational and geospatial challenges into scalable, automated, experience-led solutions that recipients love and shippers choose Amazon Shipping for.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
