new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Lightroom is the world’s leading photography ecosystem, empowering photographers to edit, manage, store, and share images across desktop, mobile, and web.

As professional photography is reshaped by AI, automation, new client expectations, and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape, we are looking for a Director of Product Management to help define what the modern professional photography workflow becomes next.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with deep product leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency in professional photography. You will represent the needs of photographers currently engaged with Lightroom, helping teams understand where pros need more speed, quality, trust, creative control, and workflow efficiency. You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy.

Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences.

This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control.

What You’ll Do

Shape the Creative Pro product agenda

Lead key product strategy workstreams for the Creative Pro audience across Lightroom surfaces including desktop, mobile, and web.
Identify high-value opportunities across professional workflows, including ingest, culling, editing, retouching, masking, batch editing, collaboration, client review, delivery, and archive.
Translate photographers’ jobs to be done into clear product principles, requirements, priorities, and success measures.
Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years.

Represent professional photographers inside Adobe

Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography.
Build relationships with professional photographers, educators, creators, camera partners, and industry experts to keep Lightroom grounded in real-world workflows.
Bring hands-on photography fluency into product reviews, prototypes, roadmap discussions, launch planning, and executive conversations.
Help teams distinguish between technically impressive ideas and experiences professionals will trust in production.

Imagine and ship new experiences

Partner with teams in advanced technology, design, and engineering to shape new capabilities into experiences photographers love and rely on.
Define how AI, agents, and automation should show up in Lightroom to save time, improve quality, reduce repetitive work, and expand creative possibility.
Balance innovation with quality, performance, reliability, transparency, and user
control.
Drive clarity and alignment across cross-functional teams, strategic forums, planning cycles, and executive discussions.

Ground decisions in insight

Stay close to the tools, services, communities, and workflows professional photographers use today.
Develop a strong point of view on where Lightroom should lead, where it should partner, and how we can exceed expectations of our most advanced customers.
Connect customer insight, product quality, adoption, retention, monetization, and competitive differentiation into precisely structured product recommendations.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Proven experience as a senior product leader who has defined strategy and shipped high-impact products, ideally for creative, media, professional, technical, or workflow-intensive customers.
Deep understanding of professional photography workflows, including speed, quality, consistency, client expectations, high-volume production, and creative control.
Strong product taste, with the ability to evaluate whether an experience meets the bar for professional use.
Experience turning ambiguous customer needs, emerging technology, and business goals into well-defined product strategy, tradeoffs, and shipped outcomes.
Experience partnering deeply with research, design, engineering, and product marketing to deliver customer-facing products at scale.
Experience with AI, automation, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic experiences, holding a clear stance on trust, control, quality, and user value.
Executive-level storytelling and influence, especially in senior IC roles where impact depends on alignment rather than direct authority.
Strong analytical judgment, showing proficiency in combining usage data, customer research, market signals, competitive insight, and hands-on craft expertise.
Excellent collaboration skills, high ownership, and a demonstrated ability to build trust with photographers and internal partners alike.

Strong Plus

Over 10 years spent working professionally as a photographer specializing in one or more genres.
Experience teaching, mentoring, writing for, or building community with photographers.
Experience collaborating with camera manufacturers, lens makers, imaging hardware companies, or other photography ecosystem partners.
A photography portfolio, shipped product examples, writing, talks, or other work that demonstrates extensive knowledge of professional creative workflows.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

new_jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Technical, Core Shopping Data Science
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon cannot fix a customer experience problem it cannot measure. Our team's job is to make shopping quality measurable: to find the defects customers actually encounter, quantify how often they encounter them, and put a number in front of leadership that teams are willing to be held to. Today that capability is strongest on the search results page, where we run a portfolio of quality metrics covering areas such as relevance, duplication, and brand quality, backed by a mix of human annotation and LLM based measurement.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager - Technical to own the quality bar for core shopping: the standard that defines what counts as a customer visible defect, how precisely it must be measured, and what evidence is required before a number can be trusted. You will drive alignment on that standard across the organizations whose experiences it judges. Owning the bar is the job. Measurement and inspection are how you enforce it: you will own the quality metric portfolio for the search page, the inspection mechanisms that surface the defects we are not yet measuring, and the scalable mechanisms (human annotation, LLM based evaluation, and the audit loops that keep both honest) that hold the system together as coverage grows. You will expand that coverage beyond search to other core shopping surfaces, including the Homepage and Detail Page.

Key job responsibilities

Define The Quality Bar

Own the standard that every metric definition, annotation SOP, and automated measurement approach must satisfy before it can be trusted or published. Scientists, engineers, and annotation partners build to that bar.
Own the portfolio of shopping quality metrics against that bar, covering areas such as relevance, duplication, and brand quality, and grow that portfolio as new defect classes are identified.

Own the inspection mechanisms

Own how we find quality defects, not just how we count the ones we already know about: sampling strategy, audit cadence, anecdote review, and systematic inspection of pages customers actually saw.
Turn qualitative signal into quantified metrics. Work with UX Research and leadership to convert customer anecdotes and research findings into defect definitions that can be sampled, scored, and tracked.
Own the audit loop and the SOP bar. Specify what gets audited and against which criteria, review findings, and require the resulting corrections in annotation SOPs or LLM prompts. When a measurement approach systematically misses a defect class, you own defining what the corrected standard is, and the team builds to it.

Drive quality measurement into online systems

Drive the agenda to move quality measurement from offline, after the fact reporting into online systems, so that quality signals are available where experiences are ranked and served rather than only in a periodic report.
Partner with central platform teams to embed quality metrics into online evaluation and serving paths.
Make the case for where online quality signals change decisions, including experimentation guardrails, faster detection of quality regressions, and closed loop correction of defective experiences.

Own the roadmap

Own the multi year roadmap for shopping quality measurement and inspection: which defects to measure next, which surfaces to expand to, and what each expansion unblocks for the business.
Extend the charter beyond search to other core shopping pages, starting with Homepage and Detail Page. For surfaces with no measurement today, define the defect taxonomy from scratch: what a quality defect is on that page, how it is sampled, how it is scored, and how it rolls up.
Drive alignment across Organic Search, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and International as definitions evolve, including with the teams whose experiences the metrics judge.

About The Team

The mission of the Core Shopping Data Science team is to provide the data-driven foundation for building a world-class shopping experience that maximizes long-term free cash flow by delighting customers. We focus on the long term and big picture to ensure that the full Amazon shopping experience balances strategic trade-offs. We believe data science is the discipline of making smart decisions and we empower feature owners and systems by 1) developing and vending metrics which assess and value customer engagement, 2) building tools and datasets to inject data into the decision-making process, and 3) delivering deep analyses to inform high-touch decisions.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's community spans developers building new products, individual Claude users, and practitioners and buyers inside enterprise accounts — from the staff engineer using Claude Code to C-Suite decision-makers. We're hiring a Head of Community to turn our current set of programs into a function that helps millions of people build real skills with Claude, measurably growing retained users and product adoption.

You'll lead and grow a global team that covers ambassadors programs, regional community leads, and enterprise champion programs. Your job is to give this team a sharp operating model and a measurement framework that ladders our initiatives to business outcomes, so users can get the most out of Claude. You'll build community across audiences, seniority levels, functions, and roles: enterprise buyers and executive sponsors, developers and technical practitioners, and the knowledge workers in between. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, PMM, Brand, and Comms.

Key Responsibilities

Own the global community strategy and operating model: the audience thesis, the portfolio of programs, and what's built centrally vs. run in-region
Lead, coach, and scale a global team of program and regional owners; hire the gaps, set the bar, and develop community-native operators
Define the measurement framework that replaces activity metrics: partner with Product and Data Science to define success metrics and segment the base (non-user → occasional → high-value daily) — with recurring retained users and product adoption as the top-line outcomes
Build community across the full range of audiences and seniority levels, with programs and voice tuned to each without fragmenting the experience
Connect bottoms-up adoption to enterprise expansion: architect the champions, train-the-trainer, and partner ecosystem motions that turn power users inside accounts into org-wide adoption, and integrate them into how Sales and CS run strategic account plans
Bring training, certification, enablement, and community help together into one engine that scales through champions and partners — so users experience a single path to skill-building with Claude
Partner tightly with Brand and Comms to keep sentiment and awareness healthy: define where community shows up in Anthropic's brand and how we best serve our users
Align community strategy proactively with product direction, launches, and pricing & packaging — owning community's job pre-launch, at launch, and post-launch, and proving it drives value for our users

Minimum Qualifications

Have built and led a community or customer advocacy function at a company where community was a growth lever, not a cost center — and can point to the retention, adoption, or expansion outcomes it drove
Have led and developed a distributed team of program owners and regional leads accountable for commercial impact
Think in funnels and segments as naturally as you think in programs: you're comfortable putting your name on a metric in a QBR and defending how community moved it
Have connected self-serve, bottoms-up adoption inside large accounts to enterprise expansion, and can articulate exactly where community sits in that motion
Can flex your playbook across very different audiences — a technical, API-first developer community and an enterprise executive buyer community are different jobs, and you've done versions of both
Operate as an integrated marketer: you've worked day-to-day with cross-functional teams and have strong opinions about how community stays customer-first
Are comfortable partnering with Product and Data Science to define usage quality, instrument it, and hold your team to it
Write and communicate clearly, hold a room with both a Staff engineer and a CIO, and are energized by ambiguity and building at speed

Preferred Qualifications

Run community or advocacy at a company operating both a PLG / self-serve motion and an enterprise sales motion at the same time
Built or led a recognized champions, ambassadors, or advocacy program at a company known for the model
Experience with developer tools, infrastructure, or AI products, and credibility with technical audiences
Built the measurement plumbing for a community function before including cohorting, attribution, and usage segmentation
International experience standing up or scaling community in-region (EMEA, Japan/APAC) with a clear philosophy on what runs centrally vs. locally
A track record of listening to communities and building user trust through hard moments alongside a Comms team
Background spanning more than one of: community, customer marketing, developer relations, customer education/enablement, or growth

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$400,000—$400,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Description

Automotive and Manufacturing is one of AWS's highest-priority industry verticals and a centerpiece of Amazon's broader enterprise strategy. Our vision is to be the most trusted technology partner for the world's automotive and manufacturing companies as they navigate the greatest transformation in their history: the convergence of AI, electrification, and software-defined everything. Three industry forces make this moment urgent: (1) the rapid shift to software-defined vehicles and autonomous mobility is rewriting how cars are built, sold, and operated; (2) generative AI and agentic AI are unlocking a new generation of smart factories, predictive supply chains, and industrial automation at scale; and (3) manufacturers are under intense pressure to reduce costs, localize production, and build resilience against geopolitical and tariff disruption. AWS is uniquely positioned to help customers across all three, and this role is at the center of that mission.

Beyond AWS, you will coordinate with other Amazon business units, including Alexa+ (voice and ambient AI for automotive), Project Leo (satellite connectivity), Amazon Ads (in-vehicle and retail media), Amazon Supply Chain Services, and Amazon Business, to bring the full breadth of Amazon's capabilities to automotive and manufacturing customers. new_jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech (PMT), HR Experience Technology
new_jobs.description:
Description

Own the product strategy for the agentic AI platform and cross-platform shared services that power HR experiences for 1.8 million Amazonians. As a Principal Product Manager - Tech in our HR Experience Tech (HRXT) team, you’ll lead product delivery for the horizontal intelligence layer—Agent Skills (our AI-native no-code automation platform), Employee 360 (the unified employee context layer), and the integration, orchestration, and routing infrastructure that makes every HR interaction smarter, faster, and more consistent across all personas.

This is a rare opportunity to define how AI agents work in HR at Amazon. We’re building the PXT skill catalog—the governed library of agentic workflows that any compatible AI agent can execute. HR professionals author deterministic, auditable workflows in plain language. These skills combine procedural knowledge (step-by-step instructions, edge cases, business rules), permissioned data access (via PXT MCP Gateway connections to E360, Case, Timehub, ETM, Manager Hub, Engage, ADAPT), and the ability to apply business rules across multiple systems to produce reliable, auditable outcomes. You’ll own this platform end-to-end—from the authoring experience through governance, versioning, and production execution.

You’ll work across a multi-product technology stack spanning agentic AI workflows, intelligent routing, automated communications, employee data platforms, and cross-platform integration layers—coordinating across all of these to deliver seamless end-to-end HR experiences while designing for Service Central, our converged AI-first platform. You’ll partner with HR operations leaders, AI/ML scientists, engineering teams across HRSC, USC, PXT CMS, and domain experts to build the composable automation framework that makes every HR team more effective.

This role demands someone who can think in platforms and composability—building horizontal capabilities that amplify every vertical team’s impact. A single Agent Skill you ship gets used by 7,000 contact center agents, 11,000 Ops HR users, 500 corporate HRBPs, and 308 investigators. A single MCP integration you connect unlocks data access across every AI experience in the stack. You’ll leverage agentic capabilities, conversational AI, intelligent orchestration, and unified employee context to transform HR support from reactive case processing to proactive, AI-driven employee experiences.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision and strategy for Agent Skills—the AI-native no-code automation platform that enables HR professionals to author, govern, version, and deploy agentic workflows in plain language, embedded in HRSC and USC.

Define and scale the PXT skill catalog—building the governed library of reusable HR workflows, establishing quality standards, governance frameworks, and the discovery/sharing mechanisms that compound institutional knowledge across the organization.

Lead Employee 360 (E360) product strategy—expanding from a data retrieval tool to a context-aware agentic platform that integrates 10+ AI workflows, enabling HR professionals to complete complex tasks through natural language with comprehensive employee context.

Own PXT MCP Gateway product direction—the registry/gateway providing Maple-permissioned connections to HR data systems, including tool filtering, auth, matching, and the roadmap for onboarding new data sources that feed both E360 and Agent Skills.

Own Auto Work Assignment (AWA) evolution—building intelligent routing that considers agent skills, workload, case complexity, and organizational context to optimize resolution time and quality across all HR domains.

Define the automated communications framework—AI-backed, template-driven correspondence at case milestones that reduces manual drafting across all personas while maintaining quality and personalization.

Lead the closed-loop experience standard—defining how cross-platform case visibility, handoffs, and task assignment work across USC, HRSC, PXT CMS, and domain boundaries (Payroll, Ops, Corp, Investigations).

Own PXT One product direction—the centralized intake platform for PXT improvement requests, providing voice-of-the-field, leadership visibility into trending themes, and mechanisms to reconcile misaligned priorities.

Drive platform analytics and Insights—delivering cross-persona reporting, operational dashboards, and the metrics infrastructure that measures automation impact, adoption, and quality.

Ensure all cross-platform services are designed as native Service Central capabilities, influencing Phase 3 architecture decisions and ensuring convergence-alignment across every investment.

A day in the life

Your morning begins reviewing Agent Skills adoption dashboards—you’re tracking how many HR professionals have authored new skills this week, which skills have the highest execution volume, and where the authoring experience is creating friction. You notice a skill authored by a Central HR team lead has been forked and adapted by three other teams—a signal that the governance and sharing model is working. You also review E360 agentic workflow completion rates and identify a newly integrated MCP tool that’s driving a 40% reduction in employee lookup time for Corp HRBPs.

Mid-morning, you join a working session with the HRSC team to define the closed-loop experience for a newly onboarding domain. Payroll is coming onto USC, and their cases frequently require handoffs to Ops PXT users in HRSC—you’re designing the cross-platform visibility, task assignment, and case handoff workflows that let both teams collaborate without context loss. You validate that AWA routing will correctly assign cases at each handoff point and that the automated communication templates fire at the right milestones to keep employees informed throughout resolution.

After lunch, you lead an Agent Skills design review with engineering. A new skill for leave-of-absence eligibility verification chains three MCP tools (Timehub, CTK, and policy data via E360), applies multi-step business logic, and produces an auditable determination. You ensure it follows the skill catalog’s governance standards—deterministic execution, version-controlled, permission-scoped via Maple—and validate that the automated communication template fires correctly when the skill completes.

In the afternoon, you present your Q3 cross-platform services roadmap to HRXT leadership. You frame the portfolio through the Service Central lens: Agent Skills becomes Service Central’s automation runtime. E360 + MCP Gateway becomes the context and integration backbone. AWA becomes the intelligent routing brain. Closed-loop becomes the cross-platform coordination standard that connects every persona. You demonstrate how one Agent Skill authored for Central HR automatically works in Service Central for any persona—the platform compounds with every skill added.

You end your day in a pre-flight session for the upcoming Agent Skills Demo with PXT leadership. You’re preparing to showcase how the platform has moved from concept to production: real HR workflows authored by HR professionals (not engineers), executing against live employee data, producing auditable outcomes. You highlight the compounding effect—every new skill signals which MCPs to onboard next, and every verified skill becomes an org-wide standard that replaces ad-hoc tribal knowledge.

About The Team

The HR Experience Technology (HRXT) team is on a mission to fundamentally reshape HR work at Amazon. We bring together PXT (People Experience and Technology) teams and harness technology to provide seamless, intuitive experiences for HR teams serving all Amazonians. Our vision focuses on elevating HR service delivery through integrated technology solutions that span multiple platforms and touchpoints.

We own six major product areas—USC, HRSC, PXT CMS, Investigations, PXT One, and M&A Integrations —plus the cross-platform services layer that makes them all work together. We serve over 18,000 HR users globally, handle 30M+ interactions per year, and are actively converging toward Service Central: one AI-native platform for ALL of HR.

Our team culture embraces innovation and experimentation, particularly in applying agentic AI to transform HR workflows. Agent Skills launched in April 2026 with strong early product-market fit, putting automation directly in HR professionals’ hands. E360 launched in December 2025 on Aza and is expanding to 10+ agentic workflows. We’re at the inflection point where these platforms compound—and this role will lead that acceleration.

As part of our team, you’ll work with talented engineers, product managers, ML scientists, and designers who are passionate about using technology to transform the employee experience. Join us to define how AI agents work in HR at Amazon.

Experience with end to end product delivery

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is on a mission to reimagine how customers discover and engage with content across the entertainment landscape. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video.

About The Team

Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short-and long-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.

Key Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will partner closely with applied scientists, product teams, and platform engineers to define and deliver highly extensible systems that fuel personalized discovery at scale. you will lead the technical strategy and architecture of Prime Video’s end-to-end personalization stack — spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, training and serving platform, candidate retrieval, multi-stage ranking, dynamic content grouping, whole page optimization, and orchestration. Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

You will bring clarity to ambiguity, complexity, ROI, planning, and trade-off etc that dramatically improves the agility, usability, and extensibility of our ML solutions. Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

Consistently meet challenging deadlines and deliver high-quality solutions that enable the Prime Video platform to scale to meet growing customer demand.
Overcome obstacles and persist in the face of setbacks to ensure critical initiatives are successfully completed.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks, communicating regularly with stakeholders on project status and issues.
Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, ML/AI fluency and large-scale data processing.
Understand the architecture and design limitations of the existing Prime Video systems, ML models, and drive technical decisions that address deficiencies and optimize performance.
Use data-driven analysis to make a compelling case for project priorities and resource allocation.
Accountable for the overall strategy and successful execution of large, complex infrastructure optimization and scaling programs.

Description

Amazon operates the world's most complex supply chain — fulfilling global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lighting fast delivery speeds. A core part of making this possible is predicting the future: How much will customers order? How long will new inventory take to arrive? What is the long-term customer impact of changes in availability and delivery speed? And much more.

We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever. Our work spans the full lifecycle: from foundational research and large-scale experimentation to production deployment and downstream impact measurement.

We need your skills to help us push the boundaries of what's possible. Amazon's SCOT Forecasting team is looking for a Sr. Product Manager-Tech with a proven ability to influence across multiple organizations and drive innovation at scale. In this role, you will define and drive the long-term vision for both established and greenfield forecasting products within an ever-evolving supply chain landscape. You will partner closely with scientists and engineers to build state-of-the-art deep learning-based systems that generate the predictions and estimates required to optimize Amazon's supply chain at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how we bring advanced science — including Deep Learning, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models — out of the lab and into production systems that serve Amazon's worldwide supply chain. And we're focused on doing it faster than ever

Key job responsibilities

Specifically, as a Sr PM-T in forecasting, you will be responsible for:

Working backwards from customer problems to define the 3-5 year vision for Forecasting products, and working with scientists and engineering to achieve that vision

Communicating, earning trust, and influencing stakeholders from multiple organizations
Working backwards from customers in the supply chain and business units to proactively identify opportunities

Description

Are you passionate about innovative technologies such as artificial intelligence, generative AI, and ambient computing? The Amazon Alexa International team in Toronto is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the expansion of Alexa+ in Canada. This is your opportunity to work on products that are making history!

Key job responsibilities

Define user needs through direct customer engagement including user research sessions, beta feedback programs, and analysis of customer support interactions to identify gaps, feature enhancements, and opportunities to grow the business.
Define creative, high-quality, simple product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision, communicating the "why" through compelling narratives that align senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the market landscape, customer needs, and competitive dynamics in Canada across English and French locales, including emerging AI/ML capabilities and their implications for product strategy.
Develop detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that can be used to create product specifications and architecture for each product and application.
Translate strategic vision into actionable plans and lead cross-functional teams to execute on priority initiatives, writing clear strategy documents (PRFAQs, one-pagers) that influence organizational priorities.
Own the end-to-end customer experience for Alexa Canada across Echo, FireTV, and additional endpoints, partnering closely with UX designers to co-create experiences that balance delight, usability, and technical feasibility.
Track launches through every step from experience review and packaging approval, to beta testing, leadership presentations, and customer launch.
Manage prioritization and trade-offs among customer experience, performance, and operational support load, using data-driven frameworks and experimentation (A/B testing, holdout groups) to validate decisions.
Continuously monitor customer experience performance using advanced analytics segmentation, cohort analysis, and causal inference to identify gaps, improvement areas, and build improvement plans with measurable success criteria.
Work closely with engineering teams and program management to deliver products to the market, demonstrating sufficient technical depth to evaluate architectural proposals, ask incisive questions about AI model behavior, and identify risks in technical approaches.
Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals.
Work collaboratively with other product managers to share frameworks, best practices, and institutional knowledge to elevate team capability.

A day in the life

As a Senior Product Manager, you will have a wide set of responsibilities to ensure our customers are delighted, including launching new Alexa-powered devices and experiences and making Alexa continuously smarter. This role is equal parts business strategy, product definition, and program delivery. You will need to thrive and deliver results in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced, and dynamic business environment operating at all levels of the organization. The ideal candidate will use a combination of analytical skills, cross-functional understanding, business judgment, technical expertise, and strategic thinking to define the programs that improve Alexa CA Customer Experience. You bring genuine technical curiosity, you stay current with advances in large language models, agentic AI, and conversational systems, and you translate that understanding into better product decisions. You regularly engage directly with customers through beta programs and feedback channels to ground your intuition in real user needs. You will work closely with many partners such as marketing, technical PMs, solution architects, engineering, content, business development, and legal to ensure customers have access to a world-class Alexa experience in Canada.

About The Team

The Alexa Canada team's mission is to deliver products and services that are delightful and locally relevant for Canadian customers. We operate within the broader Alexa International organization, scaling Alexa globally while advocating for the unique needs of customers in Canada. Our work spans product launches and feature expansion across both English and French, ensuring that every Canadian customer experiences Alexa as a trusted companion in their daily life.

Job Overview

You are responsible for customer experience with considerable complexity where problems, opportunity, and strategy may not be defined. You take the lead on initiatives and deliver independently. You influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, and organization priorities through well-crafted written narratives and data-backed recommendations that earn trust with senior leadership.

You champion exceptional customer experiences by defining requirements for Canadian customers and partnership with global stakeholders on roadmap development. You balance constraints—compliance, localization, and accessibility—with customer experience considerations. You establish direct customer feedback loops and regularly validate assumptions through qualitative and quantitative research. You monitor operational health after launch and work with teams to address issues with appropriate urgency.

You demonstrate curiosity and a desire to dive deep into the technical aspects of your product, particularly in AI/ML systems. You evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses, asking the right questions to identify risks and ensure appropriate trade-offs are surfaced before commitments are made. You understand how AI, including agentic systems and large language models, is reshaping product development and apply this understanding to make better product decisions. You proactively explore new AI capabilities, attend technical deep-dives, and maintain enough technical fluency to be a credible partner to engineering. You use all means possible, including AI, to accelerate development cycles, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation.

You demonstrate high skill at using data to drive decisions. You define success criteria, KPIs, and metrics distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You design experiments and analyze results with statistical rigor. You analyze usage data, performance metrics, customer behavior, and market trends to inform decisions and prioritize roadmap investments—going beyond surface-level reporting to uncover causal relationships and actionable insights. You use AI capabilities to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment.

You collaborate with other product managers, sharing mental models for decision-making, providing feedback on documents and strategies, and helping others grow their technical and strategic capabilities. You raise the bar for the PM community through knowledge sharing and thought leadership.

You communicate with precision and influence—crafting compelling written documents that drive alignment across teams and leadership levels. You tailor your communication to your audience, whether presenting to executives, aligning with engineering partners, or rallying cross-functional teams around a shared vision.

Description

Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.

Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.

Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing

Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against

Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain

Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements

Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems

Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
